string.text: Whispers of the Shadows
Your clan's name has started to be heard around here. A merchant named {GorevVeren_Link} in {HedefSehir_Link} wants to see you. It seems their caravans have been mysteriously disappearing lately.
You spoke with the merchant {GorevVeren_Link} and agreed to track down the bandits attacking their caravans. Find the Smuggler Caravan on the map and defeat them.
You destroyed the caravan and obtained the Encrypted Ledger. Now visit {HedefSehir_Link} and confront Gang Leader {KacakciLideri_Link} at their hideout or via the town menu.
You defied the gang leader. They threatened you and warned that the outside of the city is dangerous. Be prepared for an ambush as soon as you leave the settlement.
The gang's assassins have ambushed you outside the city! Defeat them to secure the merchant's routes.
You made a deal with the gang leader. Now go back to the merchant {GorevVeren_Link} and force them to pay tribute to the gang, while you take your own hefty cut.
You ignored the whispers of the shadows and brought justice. The caravan routes are safer now, but the underworld has marked your name.
The gleam of gold covered the color of blood. You forced the merchant into submission and became a partner of the shadows. The underworld routes are now under your protection.
How can I help you, merchant?
My caravans... Someone is attacking them! Bandits are stealing my goods, but this is no ordinary robbery; it's as if they know our routes. Please find them and finish them off.
I'll track down your caravans. Have my gold ready.
Aren't the town guards meant to protect the trade routes? Why are the watch turning a blind eye?
If you are using me for some dirty mercantile scheme, this market will be your grave. Who are you really fighting?
Merchants always have woes. What is my share in this? Is it worth my blade?
I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
I don't have time to chase after bandits right now. Find someone else.
The watch commanders receive silver-stuffed pouches each month. Beyond the city gates, Calradia knows only the law of steel. These raiders are not common scum; they strike with military precision.
Peace, warrior! I swear by the heavens I speak true. I am no saint, but these raiders strike with military discipline, and my livelihood is crumbling!
I pay handsomely for results! Retrieve my ledger and protect my enterprise, and a purse brimming with five thousand denars shall be yours.
What cargo was the caravan carrying, and where do these cutthroats make their camp?
Do you suspect anyone in particular? A rival merchant guild, or the alley gangs?

Concealed within bolts of imported silk was an encrypted ledger recording all black-market debts and discreet transactions in the city! If that ledger falls into enemy hands, my head is forfeit. The raiders were last sighted holding the pass outside the city.
The back-alley syndicate! Their gang master has been extorting ruinous protection coin from my warehouses. When I refused their latest demands, my caravans began vanishing into thin air.
An encrypted ledger of black-market debts? Sounds like your hands are just as dirty as the raiders. Why should I fight your private war?
Holding the rocky pass outside the city gives them the tactical advantage. How many blades do they command?

In Calradia, every merchant who wants to survive must dance with the shadows! If you bring back that ledger and purge the pass, 5,000 denars in pure silver is yours. Refuse, and the gang rules the trade routes!
Around two dozen well-armed deserters and cutthroats. Strike them hard before they slip into the deep hills with my cargo!
I will hunt down those raiders for the safety of the roads, merchant. But once I hold that ledger, we will have words about your transactions.
What do you want, stranger? Turn back before things get ugly!
I am here for the stolen goods and the merchant's ledger. Draw your steel!
Whose orders are you carrying out? Whose seal is stamped on those contraband crates?
If you lie to me, this sand will be your grave. Whose orders are you carrying out?
(Laughs) A mercenary dog sent by that coward merchant! That ledger belongs to the masters of the back alleys now. If you want it, bleed for it!
(Laughs) Big words for someone outnumbered! You will rot in the dirt before we reveal our masters! Cut them down!
The back-alley syndicate? So you admit you're running smuggled contraband for the city gang leader?
We take orders from {KacakciLideri_Link}! You won't leave this valley alive to tell anyone! Kill them!

(Pushes his goblet aside and studies you cold-eyed) Did you think you could stroll into my den unchecked, stranger? You may have bypassed my lookouts, but whether you leave this cellar breathing remains to be seen. Speak, before my steel tastes your throat.
Who do you think you are, barging into my territory? Speak quickly before my men gut you.
If you lie to me, this den will be your tomb. I butchered your caravan dogs and took this encrypted ledger. Who is behind you?
I found the dogs plundering the caravans and seized this encrypted ledger. You're no common bandit, who is behind this?
I routed your caravan and hold your encrypted ledger. I want to know who pulls the strings in this city before I decide whose side I am on.

(Laughs) You're just a fool who only knows how to swing a sword. That ledger is mine, and the innocent man you think is a merchant is actually a greedy bastard who stopped paying us tribute to monopolize the market.
How do the town guards and nobility overlook this smuggling? How deep does this syndicate run?
What is my share in this dark business? I do not dirty my hands without substantial coin.
Nobles feast on untaxed wine while their castellans pocket our silver. The law in Calradia is merely a whip cracked across the backs of the weak. Those with gold make the rules, and the rest obey.
Ten thousand denars from the merchant's vaults. Squeeze him dry and half is yours. Now, are you in or do you wish to test my steel?
A ruthless system, but profitable. What exact proposition are you putting on the table?
Spare me the grand speeches. How do you propose we deal with the merchant?
Instead of causing me so much trouble, let's make a deal. Eliminate that merchant, and I'll give you a cut. The city streets are ours, and you'll profit too.
They say those who seek mercy in the shadows become food for jackals... But what if I refuse to bow to either you or the merchant?
You talk of sharing profits, but extortion and blade-work always spill blood. What happens if the merchant calls the town guard?
Five thousand denars is tempting, but what guarantees do I have that your assassins won't slip a dagger between my ribs once the coin is collected?
(Resting his hand on his pommel) Then the unwritten laws of these alleys shall crush you beneath our boots, stranger. You either ally with gold or bleed under cold steel. Choose now!
The guards? I already told you, the guards eat from our hand. Squeeze him hard enough and he won't dare whisper a word to the watch. Choose now!
My word is the only law in these alleys! A dead partner brings no gold, but a loyal one keeps the routes flowing. Make your decision, stranger!
You can't escape justice. I will see you hang.
Is that so? The outside of the city can be very dangerous these days. Watch your back on the roads, fool.
I am a noble, I don't do dirty work like assassinations. But pay me a hefty cut, and I'll force the merchant to pay you your tribute.
Now you are talking like a true noble. Go convince him to pay up, and the underworld routes will welcome you.
You have returned! Tell me, did you deal with the bandits? Are my goods and caravans safe?
Your hands are tied, merchant. Pay the gang their tribute and give me my cut, or I will let them butcher you.
I read that encrypted ledger, my friend. Your hands are just as dirty as the gang's. Drop the innocent act and pay our share, or watch your empire burn.
You were supposed to protect me! Do you realize what will happen to this city's trade if the syndicate bleeds my warehouses dry? I'll call the magistrate!
The magistrate is in the syndicate's pocket, and this ledger proves your own guilt. Hand over the gold now, or my blade will do the talking.
You... you are worse than them! Fine, take the gold. I have no choice. Leave me alone!
Who are you? Stand down!
So you think crossing {KacakciLideri_Link} is a good idea? Prepare to die! We will send you and that talkative merchant to your ancestors!
Come on then, gang scum! Taste my steel!
If you lie to me or think you can frighten me, this field will be your grave! Flee before I cut you all down!
Empty threats from a dead man walking! Kill them all!

Gang Members
Merchant Guards

Black Market Wars

Your clan is now known throughout the realm, having reached Clan Tier 3. However, your past isn't letting you go. A large bounty has been placed on your head, and hired assassins are after you. Defeat them and survive!
You defeated the hired assassins and survived. Find {KatilKomutan_Link} waiting on the map and interrogate him.
You learned that {YozlasmisLord_Link} was behind the assassination attempt and secured the evidence, the Lord's Sealed Order. Now it is time to confront him.
You rejected the lord's bribe. Now you must speak with {Hukumdar_Link} to prove his betrayal.
You took a hefty hush money payment from the corrupt lord and covered up the incident. It might have been a dishonorable move, but your purse is quite full.
Even at the cost of declaring war on a kingdom, you delivered your own justice with your sword. All of Calradia should fear your wrath!
By presenting the documents to the kingdom leader, you ensured the corrupt lord's exile. You gained favor with the ruler and achieved a great political victory in the kingdom.
Spare me! Put away your weapon, I yield... Ask whatever you want, just don't kill me!
If you lie to me, this field will be your tomb! Who gave the order? Speak, or I'll take your head!
Such a well-armed band does not move without a hefty purse. Which nobleman financed this ambush?
Hired cutthroats do not risk royal patrols without a heavy purse. What grudge drove this contract?
Who sent you? Speak, or I'll take your head!
I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
Spare my life! The order was given by {YozlasmisLord_Link}. He wanted you dead because you crushed the gang and ruined his income in the past. If you want proof, his sealed order is inside my armor.

Spare my life! The order was given by {YozlasmisLord_Link}. He wanted you eliminated because he couldn't get his cut in that dark deal you made with the gang. If you want proof, his sealed order is inside my armor.
Spare my life! The order was given by {YozlasmisLord_Link}. He wanted you eliminated because you stood in the way of his black market interests. The sealed order is inside my armor.
What exactly does this decree order you to do? Who else among the court nobility is tied to this blood contract?
Where does this lord hide, and how many men garrison his hall? Answer truly if you value your skin.
The decree explicitly commands us to feed your body to the vultures and reclaim the black-market ledgers! The crimson seal belongs to his lordship's signet ring. It is undeniable proof of treason!
His castle is heavily garrisoned, but during daytime audiences he sits upon his dais guarded only by personal retainers. Take the sealed order as proof!
A highborn nobleman paying cutthroats to butcher his rivals in the dark... Calradia's chivalry is truly dead.
This wax seal is worth a king's ransom in blackmail or political leverage. Hand it over, and maybe you'll live to see tomorrow.
(Trembling, handing over the parchment) Here, take it! It has his personal coat of arms. The red seal is unbroken! Just let me vanish before his scouts find me!
Get out of here! Give my regards to your lord, tell him I am coming for him.
Give me the sealed order and crawl back to your hole. If I ever lay eyes on you again, you will lose more than your pride.
I have the proof. Now crawl back to your hole and tell your master that justice is riding toward his keep.

(Takes a sip from his silver goblet and scoffs with aristocratic arrogance) You... So you are still breathing? What insolence brings you before my dais, mercenary? My guards should have flayed you at the gate.
You... So you are still breathing? What insolence brings you before me?
If you lie to me, this castle will be your tomb! I slaughtered the assassins you sent, and I hold your sealed treason in my grasp!
I slaughtered the dogs you sent. I hold your sealed order. If I reveal this to the realm, your honor is forfeit!
Did you honestly believe a handful of gutter cutthroats could slay me, my lord? Look closely at this wax seal.
(Laughs) I am a noble, and you are merely a mercenary for hire. Who will the king believe, me or you? Still, I care little for headaches. What is your price?
Why does a highborn lord of the realm stoop to funding cutthroats and dirty street syndicates? Are your fiefs not enough for your greed?
How far does your black-market network extend? Does the king know his own vassals trade in contraband and blood?
Hush money? If you expect me to bury high treason, your purse had better match your noble arrogance.

Wars are not won on peasant tithes alone, mercenary! Keeping vassals loyal and armies garrisoned demands rivers of gold. The black market fuels the thrones of Calradia whether fools admit it or not. You stumbled into gears far larger than your petty clan.
The king knows what keeps his armies marching! Bribes flow from taverns to castles, lining the scabbards of every captain in the realm.
Twenty thousand denars! Pure imperial silver, enough to hire companies of knights. Hand over that sealed parchment and ride away rich.
They say gold washes away blood, but a traitor wrapped in ermine is still a traitor. What makes you think you can buy justice?
Twenty thousand denars is pocket change for a lord of high treason. I could bleed you dry and still give this parchment to the realm.

(Slams his goblet on the table, eyes narrowing) In Calradia, justice is whatever the man with the largest army says it is! A mercenary with a scrap of parchment does not dictate terms to a lord. Either take the twenty thousand denars and leave, or face the wrath of my entire garrison. What is your choice?!
Pay me 20,000 denars, and this matter is buried forever.
My honor cannot be bought with coin. Draw your weapon!
I am taking this order straight to the ruler. Justice will be served.
(Grins arrogantly and tosses a heavy iron-bound chest at your feet) Smart choice. Gold never lies. Take your silver and never let me see your face in my domain again.
(Draws his gilded sword, roaring to his guards) Insolent dog! You dare threaten me?! Guards, slay this wretch!
(His face turns pale with fury) The ruler?! You will never reach the court alive, mercenary! Run to the king if you dare, but you will find Calradia's courts colder than my dungeons!
Welcome to our court. What urgent matter brings you before the throne?
My liege, one of your lords, {YozlasmisLord_Link}, plotted behind your back and hired assassins to murder me. Here is the sealed proof of his treason!
I bring grave news of betrayal threatening the realm's stability, my liege. This royal decree proves {YozlasmisLord_Link} commands cutthroats from the shadows.
Certain lords believe noble blood places them above the realm's laws. I bring proof of high treason, and I expect Calradian justice to be unyielding.

(Takes the parchment, inspecting the wax seal with intense scrutiny) Treason against the crown? {YozlasmisLord_Link} has served our house for generations. Yet this crimson seal bears his signet... Tell me, how did this document come into your possession? Can you prove this is not a forged fabrication?
I was ambushed by his hired assassins on the high road. Their commander carried this sealed order inside his armor before I defeated them.
This decree was dispatched to recover an encrypted ledger tying the lord directly to the black-market extortion syndicate.

The evidence is damning. Running illegal extortion syndicates and deploying cutthroats against fellow subjects strikes at the very legitimacy of our crown. Such corruption cannot be tolerated, regardless of bloodline.
Let all Calradia see that no traitor, no matter how highborn, escapes your royal justice.
I have risked life and clan to bring this truth to the throne, my liege. I ask only for the honor and standing my loyalty deserves.
Accusing a noble is a grave matter, yet the seal is undeniably his. Such treachery shall not go unpunished. You have the realm's gratitude, and you shall be rewarded accordingly.
There they are! The bounty on your head is large enough to buy an estate. Prepare to die!
You'll have to take my head from my cold corpse, hired scum. Draw your steel!
Who paid you to hunt me? Was it a nobleman, or the alley syndicates?
You gathered fifty men just to die in the mud. Let us see if your courage matches your numbers!
(Laughs) Dead men don't need names! Cut them down, let no one take our prize!
We'll choke those arrogant words back down your throat! Attack!
Come then, let's see how sharp your steel really is!
You cannot draw steel inside a settlement!
Hired Assassins
Wounded Commander
Lord's Sealed Order
I heard you were looking for capable blades regarding your disappearing caravans.
I am looking for the master of the city's alley operations. We need to talk.
We need to discuss your debts and your business with the syndicate.
We have unfinished business regarding your hired cutthroats, my lord.
My liege, I bring urgent evidence concerning high treason within your court.
